\section{A toy communication count}\label{sec:toy-count}
\paragraph{Model.} There are two fixed parties, $P_0$ and $P_1$, connected by authenticated channels.
\paragraph{Protocol.} In the online phase, each party sends one $n$-bit string to the other in the same synchronous round. Setup is a separate phase.
\paragraph{Communication.} The two online messages is sent in one round. Their combined payload length is $2n$ bits; this count excludes setup traffic.
